name: 19103 · Philadelphia, PA
findings: ZIP 19103 (Philadelphia) has 820 nonprofit organizations. 334 of them (41%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 304 organizations.
Foundation organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (14% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 19103 (Philadelphia) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 19103 (Philadelphia) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.5 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 304 organizations here; 33% of all organizations here have no identified type.
